translation: Arjuna said: Out of supreme compassion for me, You have declared this most profound, secret wisdom concerning the inner Self (Adhyatma). By listening to Your words, this stubborn delusion of mine has been completely scattered.
For I have heard from You in extensive detail, O lotus-eyed Lord, concerning the generation and final dissolution of all living creatures, as well as Your limitless, imperishable grandeur.
O Sovereign Lord (Parameshvara)! Exactly as You have just detailed Your reality to me, so it is. And yet, I long to directly behold Your majestic Cosmic Form (aishvaram rupam), O Supreme Person!
If You evaluate, O Lord, that it is possible for my human mind to survive and look upon this sight, then, O Master of Yoga (Yogeshvara), reveal to me Your absolute, imperishable Cosmic Self!
The Blessed Lord said: Behold then, O Partha, My universal forms by the hundreds and by the thousands—infinite in their variety, radiant, and carrying endless configurations of colors and shapes!

Behold the solar deities, the elemental vectors, the forces of destruction, the twin horsemen, and the sweeping storm-gods, O Bharata! Feast your eyes upon colossal marvels that absolutely no human being has ever witnessed before in history.

Behold here today, assembled together within a single point inside My Cosmic Form, O Gudakesha, the entire, boundless universe with all its moving and unmoving entities, along with anything else your heart desires to examine!

But let it be known that you are physically incapable of looking upon Me using these fragile, biological eyes of yours. Therefore, I bestow upon you a transcendent, divine eye (divyam chakshu). Behold My majestic, universal mystery!
simple_explanation: The Vishvarupa is not a material object that can be tracked by optical lenses or captured by cameras. It represents a multi-dimensional breakthrough where the linear constraints of time and space are removed. To handle this vast data stream, the human consciousness must be elevated to a higher processing state (divyam chakshu).

translation: Sanjaya said: Having spoken thus, O King (Dhritarashtra), the supreme Master of Yoga, Hari (Krishna), then revealed to Partha His magnificent, ultimate Cosmic Form.
The Form displayed infinite mouths and eyes, infinite breathtaking vistas, adorned with radiant celestial ornaments, and brandishing countless raised weapons of divine power.

Garlanded with cosmic flowers, robed in pure celestial garments, anointed with divine fragrances—a majestic, all-wonderful, infinite Godhead looking out simultaneously from all sides (vishvato-mukham).
If thousands of suns should simultaneously burst and blaze forth together into the sky all at once, that colossal glare might approximate the overwhelming radiance of that magnificent Soul.
There, right within a single point inside the body of the God of gods, Pandava (Arjuna) witnessed the entire, vast universe with all its countless, multi-divided variables assembled together as one.
Then, utterly paralyzed with awe, his hair standing on end across his body, Dhananjaya bowed his head low before the Lord, pressed his palms tightly together in reverence, and spoke.

Arjuna said: I behold all the cosmic powers assembled within Your divine body, O Lord, along with distinct multitudes of living creatures! I see the creator Brahma seated upon his lotus throne, the great seers, and radiant, celestial serpents.

I see You branching out everywhere with infinite arms, stomachs, mouths, and eyes—Your universal form stretching to infinity in all directions! I can discover absolutely no beginning, no middle, and no final end to Your being, O Sovereign of the cosmos, O Universal Form!

I see You crowned with majesty, brandishing Your mace and discus—a colossal mass of blinding light radiating from all sides, blazing fiercely like an unyielding furnace or the morning sun, boundless and almost impossible for the eye to track.

You are the absolute, imperishable Ultimate Reality that must be known; You are the secure, supreme Reservoir of this vast universe. You are the changeless, immortal Guardian of eternal righteousness (shashvata-dharma-gopta); You are the primeval, everlasting Person— such is my definitive conviction.

I see You without beginning, middle, or end, pulsing with infinite energy, with infinite arms, with the sun and the moon acting as Your eyes, Your mouth burning like a blazing sacrificial fire, heating this entire cosmos with Your inherent radiance.

For the entire space suspended between heaven and earth, along with all the geographical cardinal directions, is packed and pervaded by You alone. Gazing upon this breathtaking, terrifying, and fierce manifestation of Yours, O Magnificent Soul, all the three worlds shake with deep anxiety.

Multitudes of cosmic beings are seen entering straight into Your form; some, paralyzed by fear, press their palms together, chanting Your name. Hosts of great sages and perfected masters cry out, "May peace prevail across the universe!" and celebrate Your glory with magnificent hymns of praise.

The forces of destruction, the solar deities, the elemental vectors, the celestial guides, the twin horsemen, the storm-gods, the ancestral spirits, along with assemblies of celestial musicians, guardians, demons, and perfected masters—all are gazing upon You, completely rooted in absolute astonishment.

Gazing upon Your colossal, universal Form, O mighty-armed Lord, with its infinite mouths, eyes, arms, thighs, feet, massive bellies, and rows of terrifying fangs—all the worlds are shaking with terror, and I am trembling right along with them.

Seeing You striking the very roof of heaven, blazing with infinite colors, Your mouths wide open, Your colossal eyes glowing like furnaces—my innermost self is completely shattered by terror, O Krishna! I can find absolutely no mental stability or inner peace left within me.

Looking upon Your terrifying jaws studded with monstrous fangs, flashing like the wild fires of absolute doomsday, I lose all sense of direction and can find no shelter anywhere. Have mercy upon me, O Sovereign of all gods, O absolute Citadel of the universe (jagannivasa)!

And there, look! All the sons of Dhritarashtra, accompanied by the entire host of earthly rulers, Grandfather Bhishma, the teacher Drona, and that warrior Karna, the son of a charioteer, along with the foremost commanders of our own army;
Are rushing headlong at top speed into Your terrifying, fang-studded mouths! Some are seen trapped directly between Your crushing teeth, their heads utterly pulverized into dust.

Just as the rushing torrents of countless wild rivers race forward and plunge headlong into the mouth of the ocean, similarly, these elite heroes of the human world are charging blindly into Your blazing, consuming mouths.

Just as moths accelerate with desperate speed and dive directly into a blazing fire only to encounter their absolute destruction, in the exact same manner, these populations are accelerating forward into Your mouths to meet their sudden death.

You are aggressively licking Your lips, swallowing down entire populations from all sides within Your blazing mouths! Filling the entire cosmos with Your blinding glare, Your fierce, terrifying rays are scorching the earth to its foundations, O all-pervading Lord (Vishno)!

Tell me plainly who You are, operating in this terrifying, fierce configuration? I bow low before You, O supreme Lord, have mercy upon me! I long to understand Your primeval reality, for I am entirely unable to comprehend the ultimate purpose of Your current activity.

The Blessed Lord said: I am colossal, all-devouring Time (Kalo-asmi), the ultimate destroyer of worlds, operating here fully expanded to wipe out these generations. Even if you completely refuse to fight, not a single one of all these elite enemy warriors drawn up here in the opposing battle lines will escape alive.
simple_explanation: This is the philosophical turning point of the war. Sri Krishna reveals that the cosmic balance has already judged Duryodhana’s empire; their lifespan has been legally terminated by the Divine Law due to their unyielding crimes. Arjuna is not being asked to decide who lives or dies; he is merely being ordered to execute a sentence that has already been passed in the court of Time.

translation: Therefore, shake off your dejection, arise, and claim your historical glory! Conquer your adversaries and enjoy a prosperous, law-abiding kingdom. These corrupt tyrants have already been neutralized by My cosmic laws long ago; act as a mere immediate instrument (nimitta- matram), O ambidextrous warrior Arjuna!

Slay Drona, Bhishma, Jayadratha, Karna, along with all the other heroic warriors who have already been structurally condemned and slain by Me. Do not allow your heart to shake with emotional anxiety; fight, and you will completely conquer your adversaries in this battle!

Sanjaya said: Having listened to these words of Keshava, the crowned warrior Arjuna, trembling violently, pressed his palms tightly together, bowed down once more before Krishna, and choking with raw emotion, spoke in a voice heavy with deep terror.

Arjuna said: It is only proper and right, O Hrishikesha, that the entire universe rejoices and overflows with love when celebrating Your glory! The terrified demons are seen scattering in all directions, while assemblies of perfected masters bow down before You in deep reverence.

And why should they not bow down before You, O Magnificent Soul, who are superior even to the creator Brahma, as the primeval Source of all existence? O Infinite Lord, God of all gods, absolute Citadel of the universe! You are the Imperishable (Akshara), matching both manifest existence (Sat), unmanifest potential (Asat), and that absolute Reality which stands supreme beyond them both.

You are the primeval Godhead, the ancient, timeless Person; You are the supreme Reservoir of this vast universe. You are the absolute Knower (Vetta), the ultimate Object to be known (Vedyam), and the highest Abode. By You alone is this boundless cosmos pervaded, O Lord of infinite configurations!

You are the wind, the lord of death, the consuming fire, the aquatic ruler, the moon, the creator Prajapati, and the ancient Great-Grandfather of all creation. I bow before You a thousand times over, and again and recursively again, I bow down before Your presence!

I bow before You from the front, I bow before You from behind, I bow before You from every single side, O universal All! Pulse of infinite energy and limitless prowess, You pack and completely wrap around everything that exists; therefore, You constitute everything.

Looking upon You merely as an ordinary companion, if I have casually shouted out, "Hey Krishna! Hey Yadava! Hey my friend!" entirely blind to this majestic grandeur of Yours, driven either by careless familiarity or raw, unthinking affection;

And if I have downplayed or treated You with humorous disrespect while relaxing, resting in bed, sitting together, or sharing meals, whether sitting alone with You or in the open presence of others, O infallible Lord—I beg absolute forgiveness from Your boundless, immeasurable Reality!

You are the Father of this entire universe with all its moving and unmoving entities; You are its most worshipful, pre-eminent Guide and Mentor. Absolutely no one exists who is equal to You in all the three worlds; how then could anyone ever surpass Your reality, O Lord of incomparable, unique power?

Therefore, prostrating my entire body flat before Your feet, I implore Your mercy, O worshipful sovereign Lord! Kindly look past my errors and endure them exactly as a loving father forgives his son, as a companion tolerates his dear companion, or as a lover forgives his beloved.

I am overjoyed to have witnessed this colossal vision that no human being has ever seen before, and yet, my mind is completely convulsed with raw terror. Reveal to me once more Your familiar, comforting form, O Lord! Have mercy, O Sovereign of all gods, O absolute Citadel of the universe!

I long to see You restored as before, crowned with Your familiar crown, holding Your graceful mace and discus in hand. Restrain this infinite expansion, O thousand-armed Universal Form, and assume Your majestic, balanced form once more!

The Blessed Lord said: Being highly pleased with your devotion, O Arjuna, I have revealed to you this supreme, universal Form by the strength of My own cosmic power (Atma-yogat). This mass of blinding light, infinite, primordial, and absolute, has never been seen before by anyone else besides you.

Neither through the mechanical chanting of the Vedas, nor by the dry execution of social sacrifices, nor by distributing massive charities, nor by performing rigid physical rituals, nor through crushing, severe bodily mortifications can I be witnessed in this Cosmic Form by anyone within the human world who lacks your depth of alignment, O foremost hero of the Kuru clan!

Allow your heart to be cured of this terrifying shock, and let this state of mental panic subside completely. Free from all fear, with your mind thoroughly pacified, look back upon My familiar, graceful form once more!

Sanjaya said: Having spoken thus to Arjuna, Vasudev (Krishna) restored his familiar, daily form before his eyes. The Magnificent Soul, assuming His gentle and reassuring physical appearance, systematically comforted the terrified warrior.

Arjuna said: Gazing upon this gentle, reassuring human form of Yours, O Janardana, my analytical thoughts have successfully returned to their balance, and I have completely regained my natural composure.

The Blessed Lord said: This universal Form of Mine which you have just witnessed is extraordinarily difficult to break into. Even the highest cosmic powers are constantly longing to catch a glimpse of this multi-dimensional vision.

I can never be seen in this universal configuration through bare scriptural study, nor by severe bodily austerities, nor by distributing material wealth, nor by performing external religious offerings, exactly as you have just directly perceived Me.
But by unswerving, single-minded devotion alone (bhaktya tv-ananyaya), O Arjuna, can I be known in essence, directly witnessed in this manner, and thoroughly entered into, O scorcher of foes!

He who performs all his actions as a dedicated worker for My mission (mat-karma-krit), who looks upon Me as his absolute goal, who is deeply devoted to Me, free from all limiting attachments, and harbors absolutely no malice or hostility toward any living creature (nirvairah sarva-bhuteshu)—he ascends directly into My being, O Pandava.
